s1_nofold.expr: day_mean(in_sustain_stddev(is_gt(sub(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), in_delay(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), 1)), add(in_mean_full(sub(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), in_delay(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), 1))), in_stddev_full(sub(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), in_delay(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), 1))))), in_slice(Ret, 2, 237), 5))
s1_nofold.why: 去掉折叠(H2 对 H3):如果收益对 J 是驼峰,不折叠的 J 多头腿应明显更差、十分位剖面两头低;如果只是「高波动差」,它的多空夏普不会低于原式

s1_rankfold.expr: abs_(cs_demean(cs_rank(day_mean(in_sustain_stddev(is_gt(sub(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), in_delay(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), 1)), add(in_mean_full(sub(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), in_delay(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), 1))), in_stddev_full(sub(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), in_delay(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), 1))))), in_slice(Ret, 2, 237), 5)))))
s1_rankfold.why: 折叠中心从截面均值换成中位数、距离从水平换成排名:如果原式的空头腿只是 J 右尾的那批票,对称的排名折叠(两端各取 5%)应明显变差

s1_fold_ivol.why: 拿掉整个事件机器(H1):同一段分钟收益的全天 std 做同样的折叠。如果放量掩码和 5 分钟窗口有内容,这个应明显更差

s1_fold_roll5.why: 保留 5 分钟窗口 std、把掩码换成全部分钟:把「掩码」和「短窗统计量」分开。它和原式一样好 = 掩码多余

s1_mask_quiet.expr: abs_(cs_demean(day_mean(in_sustain_stddev(is_gt(add(in_mean_full(sub(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), in_delay(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), 1))), in_stddev_full(sub(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), in_delay(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), 1)))), sub(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), in_delay(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), 1))), in_slice(Ret, 2, 237), 5))))
s1_mask_quiet.why: 掩码取反(ΔVolume 低于阈值的分钟,约占九成):如果「耀眼时刻」是特殊的,非耀眼时刻的同一统计量应更差

s1_win3.expr: abs_(cs_demean(day_mean(in_sustain_stddev(is_gt(sub(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), in_delay(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), 1)), add(in_mean_full(sub(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), in_delay(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), 1))), in_stddev_full(sub(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), in_delay(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), 1))))), in_slice(Ret, 2, 237), 3))))
s1_win3.why: 窗口 5 → 3:真效应应该有邻域(H8)

s1_win15.expr: abs_(cs_demean(day_mean(in_sustain_stddev(is_gt(sub(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), in_delay(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), 1)), add(in_mean_full(sub(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), in_delay(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), 1))), in_stddev_full(sub(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), in_delay(in_slice(Volume, 2, 237), 1))))), in_slice(Ret, 2, 237), 15))))
s1_win15.why: 窗口 5 → 15:同上;窗口越长越接近全天波动
